|printed_game_text=<span lang="ja">操縦する宇宙船の戦闘力に2を加える。同じ屋外位置にいる自分の宇宙船はフォースを消費せずに移動できる。「エコー基地ドッキング・ベイ」にいる場合、各ターンに1回、ホス上にいるキャラクターを1名、「シールド・ドアを閉めなければ」の効果を受けなくできる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Tamizander-Rey-PSA-156433108.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
|printed_lore=''<span lang="ja">エッセレス出身。帝国元老院の解体後にエッセレス防衛軍を辞職した。エコー基地の専任デッキ士官で、ドッキング・ベイの諸事を採配する。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
|translation='''Title:''' Tamizander Rey.

'''Card text:'''
Adds 2 to the power of a starship he pilots. Your starships at the same exterior location may move without spending Force. While at Echo Docking Bay, once each turn, one character on Hoth may ignore The Shield Doors Must Be Closed.

'''Lore:'''
A native of Esseles. After the Imperial Senate was disbanded, he resigned from the Esseles defense force. He is Echo Base's dedicated deck officer and directs docking-bay affairs.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Game text adds 2 to a 宇宙船 (starship) he pilots, not “anything he pilots.” Free movement is for starships at the same exterior 位置.
